skills.detail:
When the Trait conditions are met, Skill 2 "King of Hell, Three-Sword Serpent: 103 Mercies Dragon Damnation" evolves into the EV Skill "Guess I Might as Well Become...The King of Hell!!!", then into the EV Skill "Three-Sword Style: Purgatory Onigiri & Diable Mouton Mallet".
When you are KO'd, Skill 2 reverts to "King of Hell, Three-Sword Serpent: 103 Mercies Dragon Damnation".

Moves towards enemies at long range and attacks with a Knockback effect.
Damage dealt will disregard the enemy DEF stat.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
